answer: Admission auction: each new identity must win a weekly slot by bidding a bond in POA. Top K bids win, bonds lock 20 epochs, losers refunded minus 2 POA. An attacker faces an ocean: planting 1,000 fakes means 1,000 winning bids at the 40 POA clearing price, 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool. Its fakes form a nebula of bids, while honest agents are an oasis of real work: each pays once, keeps its slot, and earns the fee back from real tasks.
